description: Réseau d'électricité INSPIRE is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by NGI. Electricity network is the INSPIRE vector data set originated from the High-Tension network of the product TOP10Vector of the National Geographic Institute in Belgium. The Electricity network is regularly updated with the ELIA Group data sources. It includes the "ElectricityCable" features and the "Pole" features in accordance with the INSPIRE specifications. Coverage: NGI. The portal shows the English title as "Electricity network INSPIRE" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is NGI. The listing shows 3 download or service links in ATOM, WMS, GML. The listing shows 2020-10-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
